+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.
+The question is whether a bounded Node pipeline can losslessly store this complete
+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.
+Script SHA256 before execution:
+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.
+
+A pass admits a narrow candidate for uncompressed protocol transport with explicit
+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.
+It establishes neither browser timing nor overall native feasibility. Existing
+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,
+complete source attribution and the unchanged420s deadline on the reviewed candidate.
+No separate native diagnostic workflow or repeated assertion run is added. A failed
+pair stops acceptance. Reviewer B independently accepted this separation of local
+capability from native acceptance; source authority and local feasibility do not
+claim historical causality.
+
+Before validation, extend existing lowest-layer controls for lossless Unicode/chunk
+boundaries, explicit raw/stored hashes and format agreement, missing/late completion,
+known/late stream handles, stream/parse failures, cancellation and first-error-preserving
+cleanup. Keep the128-event journal bounded without losing early phases to roughly
+600 raw1MiB reads. Reuse existing helper/spec/comparator and CI selection. No new
+product behavior, generic lifecycle framework, reduced trace categories, timeout
+extension or acceptance waiver. Operator benefits from accountable collection;
+Owner/Collaborator retain content/history/callback contracts; Link guest retains
+unchanged access verification. Full outcome remains XL.
+
+Reviewer A caught an exclusive-output ownership bug before execution: EEXIST must
+not delete a pre-existing file, cleanup failure must not hide the first failure,
+and destroyed streams must settle/close before unlink. The revised probe records
+exclusive-open ownership, awaits closure and retains secondary cleanup errors.
+An external watchdog kill requires inspecting and cleaning this probe’s known
+partial output after process termination; no JavaScript cleanup is assumed then.
+No probe has run at this checkpoint.
+
+## ✅ Capability result and selected candidate
+
+**2026-11-04 · One declared probe completed; native acceptance still pending.**
+The63398b4 probe passed once:596624241 decoded bytes before and after storage,
+SHA256 `c6499a2562738465bf85b540585b9c9d18338c2cc2b01aecfd0ba59cf9464c7e`.
+Local gzip level1 produced47129287 bytes (larger than the original32556712),
+SHA256 `9faceef069c2b4b43f1eb3cadf114bf3a892da503a175ee7f4f4ca612291e3cc`.
+Recompression took1832.2ms and the complete roundtrip2786.2ms; serialized watchdog
+3043ms, sampled combined peak256160KiB, normal pressure. All owned streams closed.
+This supports bounded local storage only; it does not measure browser/CDP transfer,
+identify the old timeout's cause or promise native success. No second probe ran.
+
+Select uncompressed ReturnAsStream JSON transport with a backpressured Node gzip
+level1 pipeline. Preserve every byte and distinguish received raw count/hash from
+stored gzip count/hash and explicit producer/compression/level. The existing full
+parser recomputes raw identity while decoding, still validates every event and the
+complete envelope, and retains all analysis inputs/source attribution. Comparator
+rejects absent/mismatched storage provenance, decoded identity, source evidence,
+terminal success or confirmed session/fixture cleanup. The archive must retain
+the complete compressed raw traces, not just projected analysis.
+
+Pinned Chromium's [non-binary stream reader](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/devtools_stream_file.cc)
+trims requested text blocks to complete UTF-8 character boundaries and advances
+by returned bytes. Source SHA256
+`10abd3c335f12b2759470bd6f99f10a71d4b6480b7d647ece13890621cbc6567`.
+Controls cover both actual text chunks and arbitrary base64 byte boundaries.
+The1MiB protocol reads,64KiB stream buffers and backpressure bound live buffering;
+the larger transfer/disk/CPU cost remains part of native acceptance. Logarithmic
+byte milestones retain early phases within the existing128-event journal; final
+exact byte totals remain mandatory. No capture category,1GiB non-overwriting
+buffer, workload, throttle, baseline, callback cap or420s acceptance budget changes.
+
+### 🧹 Owned interruption and publication
+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright
+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,
+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the
+stalled protocol, and waits for execution settlement. The separate failure-only
+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;
+it cannot extend420s successful acceptance or turn a timeout into a pass. If even
+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.
+[Playwright timeout semantics](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-timeouts) and its
+[CDP close/detach contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession) support
+these boundaries; no system-wide process or browser-stream reclamation is inferred.
+
+Every failed collection path requests its known handle's one close attempt before
+starting shared interruption, without waiting on that close. The completion listener
+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.
+Pipeline failures release pending reads; Node streams/files settle before deleting
+only an owned partial output. Original failures survive secondary cleanup errors.
+Fixture cleanup shares actual per-context settlement, attempts every acquired
+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.
+
+After failed execution settles, terminal handling re-publishes a failed manifest.
+The comparator also independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress,
+so an in-flight stale passing serialization cannot override a deadline even if
+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather
+than replacing or crediting its historical failed pair.
+
+### 🔎 Review checkpoints and sustainable verification
+
+Early independent reviewers found two concrete gaps before validation publication:
+direct end-command rejection could drop late-handle ownership, and a timeout during
+final persistence could leave a stale passing manifest. Both are repaired above
+with deterministic controls. Review also added actual text transport, output failure
+while read/close requests are pending, a browserless **real Playwright timeout** using
+the production settlement helper, and real-database/fake-context partial cleanup
+controls. These preliminary reviews are not final exact-commit grades.
+
+First52 trace/progress/comparator controls passed. An expanded fixture control then
+queried an already closed database and triggered libsql's native panic; the test
+now uses the existing public isOpen witness. The failed process/log remain retained;
+its unique synthetic fixture directory was removed after process termination.
+Subsequent56 then61 controls passed after meaningful additions/repairs. Expanding
+to the unchanged source-attribution suite found four macOS path-alias assertions:
+production deliberately returned canonical/private/var paths while the fixture
+expected/var. The assertion now compares realpath of the same exact source map;
+no production attribution or security check was weakened. Preserve these failures
+and their final verification in the PR/local evidence, not as hidden retries.
+
+Existing trace/progress/comparison/source/lifetime controls own deterministic
+failure contracts; existing plan/aggregate controls prove selected missing/failed
+work cannot pass. Changed scripts/ci inputs select full coverage, including both
+historical callback pairs and independent unprofiled responsiveness, without routing
+changes or extra benchmark workflows. Current harness overlay includes every changed
+helper and the shared fixture; paired source/hash checks remain mandatory. Local
+checks obey the serial memory watchdog. Two complete exact-commit reviews above95
+are required before the first validation push; all seven gates, every selected
+worker and first-attempt native pairs remain pending until observed.
+
+Complete scope remains XL: protocol investigation, lossless persistence, cancellation,
+resource ownership, diagnostics, source attribution, regression controls, hosted
+verification and integration. The candidate does not close SPN-141/140/120; they
+retain their fresh integrated native/full acceptance obligations after this ticket.
+
+### 📦 Complete local candidate checkpoint
+
+[Maintained local evidence](evidence/SPN-143/README.md) pins source hashes, the one
+probe, early review findings/dispositions and every local attempt. Current107/107
+controls pass under the watchdog in2889ms, sampled combined peak834976KiB; focused
+nine-root types pass in444ms and full lint/dependency/format in17752ms,756064KiB.
+Backlog/index/title/whitespace checks pass. These results do not substitute for
+full hosted types, native CDP transfer/cleanup or selected current-head CI.
+
+Prepare the complete candidate with SPN-143's ticket removed, its ID appended to
+the completion ledger and its dependency removed from SPN-141. The CLI generates
+the index; next_id and last-groomed date remain unchanged. This is conditional
+landing bookkeeping, not a claim that the PR is merged. Commit this full candidate
+and obtain two independent exact-head grades before its first validation push.
+Publish one draft implementation PR for SPN-143, then run the existing selected
+first-attempt CI/Storybook owners. A failed pair stops acceptance and requires a
+supported repair/disposition; no unchanged assertion retry is authorized.

+# 🔎 SPN-143 local evidence
+
+`local.json` pins the base, nine changed executable/test source hashes, Chromium
+authority hashes, one prospective probe and completed local checks. Gzip files
+retain exact scripts, admission/early reviews, first failures, logs and watchdog
+records; they are evidence, not scripts executed by CI.
+
+- One complete retained baseline trace roundtrip passed: 596,624,241 raw bytes
+  with identical SHA256, 47,129,287 stored bytes, 2.786 s. Watchdog: 3.043 s,
+  256,160 KiB sampled combined peak, normal pressure. Local feasibility only.
+- Current controls: **107/107**, 2.889 s and 834,976 KiB sampled peak. They include
+  trace/progress/comparison, source attribution/lifetimes and CI plan/aggregate
+  failure contracts. The production settlement helper is exercised by a real,
+  browserless Playwright timeout; fixture controls use real SQLite and fake contexts.
+- Focused nine-root/import-graph types: 444 ms, sampled peak 292,688 KiB; full
+  project types remain hosted acceptance. Short sampling is not a true peak bound.
+- Full lint/dependencies/format: 17.752 s, 756,064 KiB sampled peak, normal pressure.
+  Backlog, CLI-generated index, exact PR title and whitespace checks passed.
+
+## 🧪 First failures and review dispositions
+
+`tests-second` retains the test's unsafe post-close database query and native
+libsql panic. The control now uses the public `isOpen` property; its orphaned
+synthetic fixture directory was removed only after process termination.
+`tests-final` is the first expanded 107-control attempt: four source-map assertions
+failed on macOS `/var` versus canonical `/private/var`. `tests-complete` is the
+passing result after comparing the same fixture map's canonical realpath. No
+production attribution/security behavior changed. Intermediate passing results
+remain identified separately; they do not validate later code.
+
+Early reviews found late-handle ownership after a rejected end command and stale
+passing publication during timeout. Both have explicit negative controls. Added
+controls cover native text transport, pending read/close release after output
+failure, lost/truncated/mismatched evidence, partial setup, shared cleanup, first
+cause preservation and terminal-progress rejection. Admission and early reviews
+are not the two final exact-commit grades. Native transfer cost and complete paired
+acceptance under 420 s remain pending until a reviewed candidate is validated.
+
+## 📦 Provenance and previous prerequisite completion
+
+The input trace remains in the immutable SPN-142 first-candidate archive linked
+from [the maintained decision](../../SPN-143.md); no input/output trace is duplicated
+here. Chromium sources are immutable tag URLs with SHA256 identities in `local.json`
+and the decision. All source/category/buffer/workload/callback contracts remain
+unchanged except explicit lossless transport/storage and lifecycle ownership.
+
+`spn142-receipt-*` preserves the final PR262 readback and its description-triggered
+CI **41934467037**, deliberately cancelled and verified completed/cancelled. This
+is not an acceptance run. Publication verification independently checked the
+remote immutable archive tag and all 93 manifest entries before squash merge;
+the two small verification receipts are retained here. No further PR262 body edit
+was made to report cancellation. Its source, tested merge and squash share the
+same verified tree; obsolete implementation/helper refs were cleaned with guards.

-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.

-# 📡 SPN-143 Complete historical callback trace collection and owned cleanup
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.
+The question is whether a bounded Node pipeline can losslessly store this complete
+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.
+Script SHA256 before execution:
+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.
+
+A pass admits a narrow candidate for uncompressed protocol transport with explicit
+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.
+It establishes neither browser timing nor overall native feasibility. Existing
+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,
+complete source attribution and the unchanged420s deadline on the reviewed candidate.
+No separate native diagnostic workflow or repeated assertion run is added. A failed
+pair stops acceptance. Reviewer B independently accepted this separation of local
+capability from native acceptance; source authority and local feasibility do not
+claim historical causality.
+
+Before validation, extend existing lowest-layer controls for lossless Unicode/chunk
+boundaries, explicit raw/stored hashes and format agreement, missing/late completion,
+known/late stream handles, stream/parse failures, cancellation and first-error-preserving
+cleanup. Keep the128-event journal bounded without losing early phases to roughly

+product behavior, generic lifecycle framework, reduced trace categories, timeout
+extension or acceptance waiver. Operator benefits from accountable collection;
+Owner/Collaborator retain content/history/callback contracts; Link guest retains

-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.
+The question is whether a bounded Node pipeline can losslessly store this complete
+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.
+Script SHA256 before execution:
+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.
+
+A pass admits a narrow candidate for uncompressed protocol transport with explicit
+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.
+It establishes neither browser timing nor overall native feasibility. Existing
+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,
+complete source attribution and the unchanged420s deadline on the reviewed candidate.
+No separate native diagnostic workflow or repeated assertion run is added. A failed
+pair stops acceptance. Reviewer B independently accepted this separation of local
+capability from native acceptance; source authority and local feasibility do not
+claim historical causality.
+
+Before validation, extend existing lowest-layer controls for lossless Unicode/chunk
+boundaries, explicit raw/stored hashes and format agreement, missing/late completion,
+known/late stream handles, stream/parse failures, cancellation and first-error-preserving
+cleanup. Keep the128-event journal bounded without losing early phases to roughly
+600 raw1MiB reads. Reuse existing helper/spec/comparator and CI selection. No new
+product behavior, generic lifecycle framework, reduced trace categories, timeout
+extension or acceptance waiver. Operator benefits from accountable collection;
+Owner/Collaborator retain content/history/callback contracts; Link guest retains
+unchanged access verification. Full outcome remains XL.
+
+Reviewer A caught an exclusive-output ownership bug before execution: EEXIST must
+not delete a pre-existing file, cleanup failure must not hide the first failure,
+and destroyed streams must settle/close before unlink. The revised probe records
+exclusive-open ownership, awaits closure and retains secondary cleanup errors.
+An external watchdog kill requires inspecting and cleaning this probe’s known
+partial output after process termination; no JavaScript cleanup is assumed then.
+No probe has run at this checkpoint.
+
+## ✅ Capability result and selected candidate
+
+**2026-11-04 · One declared probe completed; native acceptance still pending.**
+The63398b4 probe passed once:596624241 decoded bytes before and after storage,
+SHA256 `c6499a2562738465bf85b540585b9c9d18338c2cc2b01aecfd0ba59cf9464c7e`.
+Local gzip level1 produced47129287 bytes (larger than the original32556712),
+SHA256 `9faceef069c2b4b43f1eb3cadf114bf3a892da503a175ee7f4f4ca612291e3cc`.
+Recompression took1832.2ms and the complete roundtrip2786.2ms; serialized watchdog
+3043ms, sampled combined peak256160KiB, normal pressure. All owned streams closed.
+This supports bounded local storage only; it does not measure browser/CDP transfer,
+identify the old timeout's cause or promise native success. No second probe ran.
+
+Select uncompressed ReturnAsStream JSON transport with a backpressured Node gzip
+level1 pipeline. Preserve every byte and distinguish received raw count/hash from
+stored gzip count/hash and explicit producer/compression/level. The existing full
+parser recomputes raw identity while decoding, still validates every event and the
+complete envelope, and retains all analysis inputs/source attribution. Comparator
+rejects absent/mismatched storage provenance, decoded identity, source evidence,
+terminal success or confirmed session/fixture cleanup. The archive must retain
+the complete compressed raw traces, not just projected analysis.
+
+Pinned Chromium's [non-binary stream reader](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/devtools_stream_file.cc)
+trims requested text blocks to complete UTF-8 character boundaries and advances
+by returned bytes. Source SHA256

+### 🧹 Owned interruption and publication
+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright
+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,
+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the
+stalled protocol, and waits for execution settlement. The separate failure-only
+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;
+it cannot extend420s successful acceptance or turn a timeout into a pass. If even
+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.
+[Playwright timeout semantics](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-timeouts) and its
+[CDP close/detach contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession) support
+these boundaries; no system-wide process or browser-stream reclamation is inferred.
+
+Every failed collection path requests its known handle's one close attempt before
+starting shared interruption, without waiting on that close. The completion listener
+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.
+Pipeline failures release pending reads; Node streams/files settle before deleting
+only an owned partial output. Original failures survive secondary cleanup errors.
+Fixture cleanup shares actual per-context settlement, attempts every acquired
+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.
+
+After failed execution settles, terminal handling re-publishes a failed manifest.
+The comparator also independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress,
+so an in-flight stale passing serialization cannot override a deadline even if
+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather
+than replacing or crediting its historical failed pair.

+

-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.

-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.
+The question is whether a bounded Node pipeline can losslessly store this complete
+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.
+Script SHA256 before execution:
+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.
+
+A pass admits a narrow candidate for uncompressed protocol transport with explicit
+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.
+It establishes neither browser timing nor overall native feasibility. Existing
+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,
+complete source attribution and the unchanged420s deadline on the reviewed candidate.
+No separate native diagnostic workflow or repeated assertion run is added. A failed
+pair stops acceptance. Reviewer B independently accepted this separation of local
+capability from native acceptance; source authority and local feasibility do not
+claim historical causality.
+
+Before validation, extend existing lowest-layer controls for lossless Unicode/chunk
+boundaries, explicit raw/stored hashes and format agreement, missing/late completion,
+known/late stream handles, stream/parse failures, cancellation and first-error-preserving
+cleanup. Keep the128-event journal bounded without losing early phases to roughly
+600 raw1MiB reads. Reuse existing helper/spec/comparator and CI selection. No new
+product behavior, generic lifecycle framework, reduced trace categories, timeout
+extension or acceptance waiver. Operator benefits from accountable collection;
+Owner/Collaborator retain content/history/callback contracts; Link guest retains
+unchanged access verification. Full outcome remains XL.
+
+Reviewer A caught an exclusive-output ownership bug before execution: EEXIST must
+not delete a pre-existing file, cleanup failure must not hide the first failure,
+and destroyed streams must settle/close before unlink. The revised probe records
+exclusive-open ownership, awaits closure and retains secondary cleanup errors.
+An external watchdog kill requires inspecting and cleaning this probe’s known
+partial output after process termination; no JavaScript cleanup is assumed then.
+No probe has run at this checkpoint.
+
+## ✅ Capability result and selected candidate
+
+**2026-11-04 · One declared probe completed; native acceptance still pending.**
+The63398b4 probe passed once:596624241 decoded bytes before and after storage,
+SHA256 `c6499a2562738465bf85b540585b9c9d18338c2cc2b01aecfd0ba59cf9464c7e`.
+Local gzip level1 produced47129287 bytes (larger than the original32556712),

+Recompression took1832.2ms and the complete roundtrip2786.2ms; serialized watchdog
+3043ms, sampled combined peak256160KiB, normal pressure. All owned streams closed.
+This supports bounded local storage only; it does not measure browser/CDP transfer,
+identify the old timeout's cause or promise native success. No second probe ran.
+
+Select uncompressed ReturnAsStream JSON transport with a backpressured Node gzip
+level1 pipeline. Preserve every byte and distinguish received raw count/hash from
+stored gzip count/hash and explicit producer/compression/level. The existing full
+parser recomputes raw identity while decoding, still validates every event and the
+complete envelope, and retains all analysis inputs/source attribution. Comparator
+rejects absent/mismatched storage provenance, decoded identity, source evidence,
+terminal success or confirmed session/fixture cleanup. The archive must retain
+the complete compressed raw traces, not just projected analysis.
+
+Pinned Chromium's [non-binary stream reader](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/devtools_stream_file.cc)
+trims requested text blocks to complete UTF-8 character boundaries and advances
+by returned bytes. Source SHA256
+`10abd3c335f12b2759470bd6f99f10a71d4b6480b7d647ece13890621cbc6567`.
+Controls cover both actual text chunks and arbitrary base64 byte boundaries.
+The1MiB protocol reads,64KiB stream buffers and backpressure bound live buffering;
+the larger transfer/disk/CPU cost remains part of native acceptance. Logarithmic
+byte milestones retain early phases within the existing128-event journal; final
+exact byte totals remain mandatory. No capture category,1GiB non-overwriting
+buffer, workload, throttle, baseline, callback cap or420s acceptance budget changes.
+
+### 🧹 Owned interruption and publication
+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright
+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,
+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the
+stalled protocol, and waits for execution settlement. The separate failure-only
+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;
+it cannot extend420s successful acceptance or turn a timeout into a pass. If even
+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.
+[Playwright timeout semantics](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-timeouts) and its
+[CDP close/detach contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession) support
+these boundaries; no system-wide process or browser-stream reclamation is inferred.
+
+Every failed collection path requests its known handle's one close attempt before
+starting shared interruption, without waiting on that close. The completion listener
+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.
+Pipeline failures release pending reads; Node streams/files settle before deleting
+only an owned partial output. Original failures survive secondary cleanup errors.
+Fixture cleanup shares actual per-context settlement, attempts every acquired
+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.
+
+After failed execution settles, terminal handling re-publishes a failed manifest.
+The comparator also independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress,
+so an in-flight stale passing serialization cannot override a deadline even if
+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather
+than replacing or crediting its historical failed pair.
+
+### 🔎 Review checkpoints and sustainable verification
+
+Early independent reviewers found two concrete gaps before validation publication:
+direct end-command rejection could drop late-handle ownership, and a timeout during

-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.

-
-## Out of scope

-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-

-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.

+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.

+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright

+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the

+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;

+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.

+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.

+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.

+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather

+failure contracts; existing plan/aggregate controls prove selected missing/failed

-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration

+cause of Chromium's delay.

+

+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,

+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage

+

-# 📡 SPN-143 Complete historical callback trace collection and owned cleanup
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)

+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+

+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.

+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.

+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.

+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.

+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,

+## ✅ Capability result and selected candidate
+
+**2026-11-04 · One declared probe completed; native acceptance still pending.**

+### 🧹 Owned interruption and publication
+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright
+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,
+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the
+stalled protocol, and waits for execution settlement. The separate failure-only
+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;
+it cannot extend420s successful acceptance or turn a timeout into a pass. If even
+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.
+[Playwright timeout semantics](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-timeouts) and its
+[CDP close/detach contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession) support
+these boundaries; no system-wide process or browser-stream reclamation is inferred.

+Every failed collection path requests its known handle's one close attempt before
+starting shared interruption, without waiting on that close. The completion listener
+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.
+Pipeline failures release pending reads; Node streams/files settle before deleting
+only an owned partial output. Original failures survive secondary cleanup errors.
+Fixture cleanup shares actual per-context settlement, attempts every acquired
+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.
+
+After failed execution settles, terminal handling re-publishes a failed manifest.
+The comparator also independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress,
+so an in-flight stale passing serialization cannot override a deadline even if
+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather
+than replacing or crediting its historical failed pair.
+
+### 🔎 Review checkpoints and sustainable verification
+
+Early independent reviewers found two concrete gaps before validation publication:
+direct end-command rejection could drop late-handle ownership, and a timeout during
+final persistence could leave a stale passing manifest. Both are repaired above
+with deterministic controls. Review also added actual text transport, output failure
+while read/close requests are pending, a browserless **real Playwright timeout** using

+
+Existing trace/progress/comparison/source/lifetime controls own deterministic
+failure contracts; existing plan/aggregate controls prove selected missing/failed
+work cannot pass. Changed scripts/ci inputs select full coverage, including both
+historical callback pairs and independent unprofiled responsiveness, without routing
+changes or extra benchmark workflows. Current harness overlay includes every changed

+retain their fresh integrated native/full acceptance obligations after this ticket.
+

+

-# 📡 SPN-143 Complete historical callback trace collection and owned cleanup
-
-## Story
-
-As the [Operator](../product/personas.md#operator), I want complete and trustworthy callback evidence, so that a passing comparison proves the baseline and candidate finished their required observations and cleanup.
-
-## Scenarios
-
-### The historical pair completes its collection contract
-
-Given the pinned historical baseline and current candidate with the same callback harness,
-When each performs the existing native editing and disposal workload,
-Then its complete trace, source attribution and owned-resource cleanup are retained within the existing budget,
-And incomplete collection fails with its first cause and durable terminal progress.
-
-## Rules
-
-- Follow [sustainable testing](../testing.md); keep the Verify plan and progress evidence current. [Policy](../implementation/SPN-115.md#guidance-for-every-open-ticket-and-progress-checkpoint), owner 2026-11-01.
-- Preserve the [trace-completion failure and XL outcome](../implementation/SPN-143.md#registration-and-scope), agent judgment 2026-11-04 under the owner's request to continue SPN-120 repair. This independently discovered owner is an additional prerequisite of SPN-141; it does not replace SPN-142 or authorize a failed current gate.
-- Investigate overall deadline use, Chromium trace-completion authority and owned cleanup before selecting a repair; declare finite diagnostics and stop/reassess at the first capability checkpoint.
-- Preserve the pinned baseline, full native workload, trace attribution/category requirements, callback caps, input/content/access behavior, first-attempt rule and existing time/resource budgets. No unchanged assertion rerun, baseline skip, timeout extension or incomplete-trace acceptance.
-- Keep SPN-134's bounded durable progress and original failure; absence of evidence is not proof of browser errors or lost data. Cleanup must not mask the first failure or claim completion without witnesses.
-
-## Out of scope
-
-- SPN-142's composition work, SPN-141's storage-loss preparation, SPN-140's Safari constructor, product features and SPN-120's finite audit.
-
-## Verify
-
-- Extend existing callback trace/progress/source controls and paired comparator tests at the lowest meaningful layer; prove missing/late completion, stream/parse failure, cancellation and cleanup cannot pass or overwrite the first cause.
-- Reuse e2e/doc-responsiveness-callbacks.spec.ts and its trace/progress/source helpers; retain distinct desktop/mobile historical-pair ownership and complete source/shared-dependency routing.
-- Before native execution, record exact source/instrumentation, one discriminating hypothesis, finite count/budget, owned resources and stop condition. Diagnostic passes are not unprofiled acceptance or permission to repeat assertions.
-- Require first-attempt complete historical/candidate pairs, all source/trace hashes and cleanup evidence, unchanged native behavior/caps, all selected current-head gates and two exact-commit independent grades. Preserve every failure and disposition durably.

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: lossless local transport storage
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+landed in SPN-142 squash `eb32117f5d09c28cd411063256db6d645335ae8a`.
+Read-only inspection found the completion listener is installed before Tracing.end,
+but has no cancellation/session-close settlement. Later owned cleanup can remain
+unreached while that event is pending. This is an ownership gap, not a proven
+cause of Chromium's delay.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 [handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc)
+and [endpoint](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/tracing/tracing_controller_impl_data_endpoint.cc)
+show gzip finalization on a BEST_EFFORT sequenced runner before the completion
+event is delivered. Compression is one dependency; producer flush, serialization,
+scheduling and event delivery remain uncertain. The existing accepted2b mobile
+baseline had596624241 raw bytes,32556712 gzip bytes and86.669s completion wait.
+Those observations belong to another successful capture, not the absent failed trace.
+
+Declare exactly **one** local feasibility probe on that immutable baseline trace,
+retained in archive `67aef6cb7e4d2a58b778a8ab36c1cb8a82d1007f`, original gzip SHA256
+`5e4eb36be8be53658a70b7997c1bc5a5cd28fe14d0c5730884ebbbdddf343e08`.
+The question is whether a bounded Node pipeline can losslessly store this complete
+raw byte stream, not whether gzip caused the old timeout. On Node26.12.1, stream
+the existing gzip through gunzip, raw SHA256/count, gzip level1, stored SHA256/count
+and an exclusively created file; then stream-decode that file and require identical
+raw hash/count. No whole-trace buffering or event parsing. All input/output/zlib
+streams use64KiB chunks/backpressure. Limits:120s total, normal memory pressure,
+2GiB combined process tree under the existing serialized watchdog,768MiB raw and
+128MiB output. Stop on the first mismatch, truncation, resource or cleanup failure;
+retain it, delete failed partial output, and authorize no automatic second sample.
+Script SHA256 before execution:
+`63398b41875dff37399fee0b7fa08106635c9b16a7b983afb27d2d42a50dbd8d`.
+
+A pass admits a narrow candidate for uncompressed protocol transport with explicit
+local gzip storage provenance, bounded progress and owned interruption/cleanup.
+It establishes neither browser timing nor overall native feasibility. Existing
+selected desktop/mobile historical-pair CI owns actual CDP transfer, total cost,
+complete source attribution and the unchanged420s deadline on the reviewed candidate.
+No separate native diagnostic workflow or repeated assertion run is added. A failed
+pair stops acceptance. Reviewer B independently accepted this separation of local
+capability from native acceptance; source authority and local feasibility do not
+claim historical causality.
+
+Before validation, extend existing lowest-layer controls for lossless Unicode/chunk
+boundaries, explicit raw/stored hashes and format agreement, missing/late completion,
+known/late stream handles, stream/parse failures, cancellation and first-error-preserving

+600 raw1MiB reads. Reuse existing helper/spec/comparator and CI selection. No new
+product behavior, generic lifecycle framework, reduced trace categories, timeout
+extension or acceptance waiver. Operator benefits from accountable collection;
+Owner/Collaborator retain content/history/callback contracts; Link guest retains
+unchanged access verification. Full outcome remains XL.
+
+Reviewer A caught an exclusive-output ownership bug before execution: EEXIST must
+not delete a pre-existing file, cleanup failure must not hide the first failure,
+and destroyed streams must settle/close before unlink. The revised probe records
+exclusive-open ownership, awaits closure and retains secondary cleanup errors.
+An external watchdog kill requires inspecting and cleaning this probe’s known
+partial output after process termination; no JavaScript cleanup is assumed then.
+No probe has run at this checkpoint.
+
+## ✅ Capability result and selected candidate
+
+**2026-11-04 · One declared probe completed; native acceptance still pending.**
+The63398b4 probe passed once:596624241 decoded bytes before and after storage,
+SHA256 `c6499a2562738465bf85b540585b9c9d18338c2cc2b01aecfd0ba59cf9464c7e`.

+level1 pipeline. Preserve every byte and distinguish received raw count/hash from
+stored gzip count/hash and explicit producer/compression/level. The existing full
+parser recomputes raw identity while decoding, still validates every event and the
+complete envelope, and retains all analysis inputs/source attribution. Comparator
+rejects absent/mismatched storage provenance, decoded identity, source evidence,
+terminal success or confirmed session/fixture cleanup. The archive must retain
+the complete compressed raw traces, not just projected analysis.
+

+exact byte totals remain mandatory. No capture category,1GiB non-overwriting
+buffer, workload, throttle, baseline, callback cap or420s acceptance budget changes.
+
+### 🧹 Owned interruption and publication
+
+Keep one owned execution and shared CDP/context cleanup promises. A real Playwright
+timeout records its original terminal phase synchronously before any cleanup await,
+signals interruption, starts detachment and context closure without waiting on the
+stalled protocol, and waits for execution settlement. The separate failure-only
+teardown allowance is30s, reduced from Playwright's default same-as-test allowance;
+it cannot extend420s successful acceptance or turn a timeout into a pass. If even
+teardown cannot settle, the earlier timeout remains durable and cleanup is unconfirmed.
+[Playwright timeout semantics](https://playwright.dev/docs/test-timeouts) and its
+[CDP close/detach contract](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-cdpsession) support
+these boundaries; no system-wide process or browser-stream reclamation is inferred.
+
+Every failed collection path requests its known handle's one close attempt before
+starting shared interruption, without waiting on that close. The completion listener
+remains owned through interruption, including late handles after Tracing.end rejects.
+Pipeline failures release pending reads; Node streams/files settle before deleting
+only an owned partial output. Original failures survive secondary cleanup errors.
+Fixture cleanup shares actual per-context settlement, attempts every acquired
+context, closes its database even when a context close fails, and accounts for
+late/partial acquisitions. Failed partial setup retains the original error and
+cannot claim confirmed cleanup if its own disposal fails.
+
+After failed execution settles, terminal handling re-publishes a failed manifest.
+The comparator also independently rejects missing/failed/timed-out terminal progress,
+so an in-flight stale passing serialization cannot override a deadline even if
+later cleanup/persistence cannot finish. Successful cleanup remains inside the
+original observation deadline. This extends SPN-134's evidence contract rather
+than replacing or crediting its historical failed pair.
+
+### 🔎 Review checkpoints and sustainable verification
+
+Early independent reviewers found two concrete gaps before validation publication:
+direct end-command rejection could drop late-handle ownership, and a timeout during
+final persistence could leave a stale passing manifest. Both are repaired above
+with deterministic controls. Review also added actual text transport, output failure
+while read/close requests are pending, a browserless **real Playwright timeout** using
+the production settlement helper, and real-database/fake-context partial cleanup
+controls. These preliminary reviews are not final exact-commit grades.
+
+First52 trace/progress/comparator controls passed. An expanded fixture control then
+queried an already closed database and triggered libsql's native panic; the test
+now uses the existing public isOpen witness. The failed process/log remain retained;
+its unique synthetic fixture directory was removed after process termination.
+Subsequent56 then61 controls passed after meaningful additions/repairs. Expanding
+to the unchanged source-attribution suite found four macOS path-alias assertions:
+production deliberately returned canonical/private/var paths while the fixture
+expected/var. The assertion now compares realpath of the same exact source map;
+no production attribution or security check was weakened. Preserve these failures
+and their final verification in the PR/local evidence, not as hidden retries.
+
+Existing trace/progress/comparison/source/lifetime controls own deterministic
+failure contracts; existing plan/aggregate controls prove selected missing/failed
+work cannot pass. Changed scripts/ci inputs select full coverage, including both
+historical callback pairs and independent unprofiled responsiveness, without routing
+changes or extra benchmark workflows. Current harness overlay includes every changed
+helper and the shared fixture; paired source/hash checks remain mandatory. Local
+checks obey the serial memory watchdog. Two complete exact-commit reviews above95
+are required before the first validation push; all seven gates, every selected
+worker and first-attempt native pairs remain pending until observed.
+
+Complete scope remains XL: protocol investigation, lossless persistence, cancellation,
+resource ownership, diagnostics, source attribution, regression controls, hosted
+verification and integration. The candidate does not close SPN-141/140/120; they
+retain their fresh integrated native/full acceptance obligations after this ticket.
+
+### 📦 Complete local candidate checkpoint
+
+[Maintained local evidence](evidence/SPN-143/README.md) pins source hashes, the one
+probe, early review findings/dispositions and every local attempt. Current107/107
+controls pass under the watchdog in2889ms, sampled combined peak834976KiB; focused
+nine-root types pass in444ms and full lint/dependency/format in17752ms,756064KiB.
+Backlog/index/title/whitespace checks pass. These results do not substitute for
+full hosted types, native CDP transfer/cleanup or selected current-head CI.
+
+Prepare the complete candidate with SPN-143's ticket removed, its ID appended to
+the completion ledger and its dependency removed from SPN-141. The CLI generates
+the index; next_id and last-groomed date remain unchanged. This is conditional
+landing bookkeeping, not a claim that the PR is merged. Commit this full candidate
